items.source: Uses of ApplicationContextAssert in org.springframework.boot.test.context.assertj
AssertJ assertions that can be applied to an ApplicationContext.
items.translation: AssertJ assertions 可应用于 ApplicationContext。

items.source: An ApplicationContext that additionally supports AssertJ style assertions.
items.translation: 一个支持 AssertJ 风格断言的 ApplicationContext。

items.source:
Verifies that the application context (or ancestors) does not contain any beans of
the given type.
items.translation: 验证应用程序上下文（或其祖先）不包含给定类型的任何 Bean。

items.source: Verifies that the application context does not contain any beans of the given type.
items.translation: 验证应用程序上下文不包含给定类型的任何 Bean。

items.source: Verifies that the application context does not contain a beans of the given name.
items.translation: 验证应用程序上下文不包含给定名称的 Bean。

items.source: Verifies that the application context contains a bean with the given name.
items.translation: 验证应用程序上下文是否包含具有给定名称的 Bean。

items.source: Verifies that the application has failed to start.
items.translation: 验证应用程序启动失败。

items.source: Verifies that the application has not failed to start.
items.translation: 验证应用程序未启动失败。

items.source:
Verifies that the application context (or ancestors) contains a single bean with
the given type.
items.translation: 验证应用程序上下文（或其祖先）是否包含一个给定类型的 Bean。

items.source: Verifies that the application context contains a single bean with the given type.
items.translation: 验证应用程序上下文是否包含一个给定类型的 Bean。
